tools.description: Use when you or the user must choose a tool, API or provider for a task (send email, take payments, host a database…): send the task in a few plain words ('send an invoice') with filters if they matter. Returns the products our agent drove for it, ranked by how far an agent got on its own (sign-up, key, the work, paying), each with what happened and its sign-up, docs and MCP links. Read-only, no key needed; 5 by default, up to 25; a product by name: search_tools.
tools.name: choose_provider_for_task
tools.title: Choose a provider

tools.description: Use when you have a product's name, domain or kind in mind: send a short query ('stripe.com', 'postgres', 'invoicing') with filters for category, agent level, access or payment. Returns the products we drove, sorted by agent level (0-5), each with where our agent stopped; a task in plain words: choose_provider_for_task, one product in full: get_provider. Read-only, no key needed; up to 100 a page.
tools.name: search_tools
tools.title: Search the directory

tools.description: Use when you are about to use or recommend a product and need to know if an agent can work it on its own: send its slug from search_tools, or its name or domain. Returns its drive result: agent level (0-5), where our agent stopped, what it can and can't do, how it gets in and pays; only its API, MCP and CLI: get_agent_surfaces. Read-only, no key needed; the headline unless brief is false.
tools.name: get_provider
tools.title: Get one product's drive result

tools.description: Use when you picked a product and need to wire it up: its API, MCP server, CLI, SDK, docs and payment, each tested, documented, none_found or unknown, with the product's own URL for it and the date we saw it. The whole drive result: get_provider. Read-only, no key needed; about 1 KB.
tools.name: get_agent_surfaces
tools.title: What an agent can use at a product

tools.description: Use when you or the user are deciding between 2 or 3 products for one task ('Stripe or Paddle?'): send their slugs (from search_tools), names or domains, and the task in a few plain words. For each: driven or only listed, agent level (0-5), how far our agent got at each step and where it stopped, what it did on the task, how to connect (MCP, API, CLI), the date and its page; a name we don't cover comes back in not_covered. Read-only, no key needed.
tools.name: compare_providers
tools.title: Compare products for a task

tools.description: Use when you need a valid category id for choose_provider_for_task, search_tools or get_category: every category with its id, name, number of products and best agent level (0-5). Read-only, no key needed; no arguments.
tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List categories

tools.description: Use when you need to know whether a product you picked still works as it did, or what moved lately: with a slug, every dated change at that product (level, surfaces, price and plan, each with its source); without, the level moves of the last days, newest first, with the cause and the level now. Its full drive result: get_provider. Read-only, no key needed; narrow it with days or category.
tools.name: list_changes
tools.title: What changed lately

tools.description: Use when you know the category and want a shortlist: its name, how many products AgentDrives drove in it, the best agent level (0-5) and its top 10 by level, each with its drive date and page. The rest: search_tools with the same category. Read-only, no key needed.
tools.name: get_category
tools.title: Get one category
